t: What Does The Name Awil Mean?
s: In Somali and broader Horn of Africa usage, Awil (also spelled Awiil or Awil Ali as a compound patronymic) is common among Somali-speaking communities, where it is often linked to Arabic-Islamic onomastics and interpreted along the lines of “the first,” “primordial,” or “born first,” by association with Arabic Awwal (al-Awwal, “the First,” one of the divine epithets).
